This is a standalone alternate entry point (run directly via `python ollama-eng.py`, not imported by app.py/ce3.py) built entirely on the ollama SDK against a local Ollama server, using model 'mistral-nemo' -- a self-hosted local model, not a Router catalog id, and Router does not serve the Ollama vendor endpoint under the shared key at all. Two further call sites on the same client exist at lines 804 and 898 (both `client.chat(...)`, same ollama.AsyncClient, same mistral-nemo model) that the scanner did not individually surface but share the identical determination. A human could decide to swap this engine to a hosted Claude/OpenAI model via Router, but that changes the product's local/offline-first value proposition, so this is left as-is per the 'local or self-hosted model the app exists to use' guidance.
